title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.02403v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models has become a popular paradigm for embodied control. However, the standard planning cost judges a candidate solely by how close its predicted terminal state lies to the goal, leaving the realizability of the intermediate transitions unchecked--a predicted trajectory can look convincing while the environment rollout drifts away from it. In this paper, we propose ACID, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on. We fold this per-step residual into the planning cost via a scale-invariant adaptive weight. translated_title: ACID：基于逆动力学的动作一致性世界模型规划方法
translated_abstract: 基于动作条件化世界模型的决策时规划已成为具身控制领域的一种流行范式。然而，标准的规划代价仅通过预测终止状态与目标的接近程度来评判候选动作，而未对中间状态转移的可实现性进行检查——一条预测轨迹可能看起来很有说服力，但环境实际执行（rollout）却会偏离该轨迹。在本文中，我们提出了ACID，一个引入循环动作一致性（cycle action consistency）的决策时规划框架：由逆动力学模型从预测状态转移中反向推断出的动作，应当能够恢复出当初作为条件输入的那个动作。我们通过一个尺度不变的自适应权重，将这种逐步残差融入到规划代价之中。在涵盖四个动作条件化世界模型和八个任务（包括仿真中的物体操控与铰接关节控制、视觉导航以及真实机器人操控）的实验中，ACID持续带来性能提升。
tldr: 提出ACID决策时规划框架，利用逆动力学模型引入循环动作一致性约束，检验预测轨迹中间转移的可实现性，并将其以尺度不变自适应权重融入规划代价，在四个世界模型与八个仿真及真实机器人任务上均取得一致的性能提升。
en_tdlr: ACID introduces cycle action consistency via an inverse dynamics model into the decision-time planning cost with a scale-invariant adaptive weight, checking the realizability of intermediate transitions and consistently improving performance across four action-conditioned world models and eight simulation and real-robot tasks.
